<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools.mjs from Dogubako 0.1.0-alpha.1. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

Dogubako 0.1.0-alpha.1 has **249 tools** in 12 categories. Each category page lists every tool with its description, CLI usage and all of its options.

- **Native** tools run inside Dogubako with nothing else installed (156 tools).
- **External engine** tools call a program such as FFmpeg or Tesseract that you install separately (77 tools). See [Engines and models](/app/engines-and-models/).
- **Local model** tools need a downloaded model, such as a Whisper model for transcription (6 tools).
- **Network** tools make outbound requests and need the `network` permission (10 tools).

The same catalog is available as JSON at [`/tools.json`](/tools.json), from `dogubako tools list --json`, and from a running server at `GET /api/v1/tools`.

| Category | Tools | Native | External | Model | Network |
